Infection less likely but PAS/culture and HSV/VZV PCR pending. DIF, ANA, anti-dsDNA, anti-Ro/La, C3/C4, drug timeline missing. All key data covered; pathologic correlation needed.

payload.report: Patient has a 1-month pruritic, painful periorbital eruption with scaly crusted pink plaques. Biopsy shows vacuolar interface dermatitis with follicular involvement and epidermal atrophy, classic for discoid lupus erythematosus (DLE). Her lupus nephritis supports autoimmunity, and the pathologist favors DLE while infection is unlikely (no fungal elements or viral cytopathic changes). Subacute, acute, and drug-induced cutaneous lupus fit poorly. Diagnosis: DLE, pending DIF and serologies.
